digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Maundu & Tengnäs 2005 (Muhumba mkulu)

teaser.en: Bright yellow flowers, then pods so long and dark they hang like walking sticks from the branches.
teaser.sw: Maua ya njano angavu, kisha maganda marefu na meusi kiasi kwamba yananing'inia kutoka matawini kama fimbo za kutembelea.

summary.en: *Muhumba tsaka*, the long-pod cassia, is a small tree of bushland and forest edges with yellow flower clusters and very long dark pods. Its bark and roots are used in traditional medicine, and its wood for timber and poles.
summary.sw: *Muhumba tsaka*, au *mbaraka*, ni mti mdogo wa vichaka na pembezoni mwa misitu wenye vishada vya maua ya njano na maganda marefu sana yenye rangi nyeusi. Gome na mizizi yake hutumika katika tiba ya jadi, na mbao zake kwa mbao za ujenzi na nguzo.

about.en: *Muhumba tsaka* is a small tree. It bears clusters of bright yellow flowers, followed by its most distinctive feature: very long, cylindrical, dark pods that hang from the branches.
about.sw: *Muhumba tsaka* ni mti mdogo. Huzaa vishada vya maua ya njano angavu, vinavyofuatwa na sifa yake bainifu zaidi: maganda marefu sana, yenye umbo la mcheduara na rangi nyeusi, yanayoning'inia kutoka matawini.

where.en: It grows in bushland and at the edges of coastal forest.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka na pembezoni mwa misitu ya pwani.

uses.en: The bark and roots are used in traditional medicine. The wood is used for timber and poles. Among the Giriama, it is used to mark graves.
uses.sw: Gome na mizizi hutumika katika tiba ya jadi. Mbao zake hutumika kwa mbao za ujenzi na nguzo. Miongoni mwa Wagiriama, hutumika kuweka alama kwenye makaburi.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *muhumba tsaka*; the ICRAF handbook gives *muhumba mkulu*, which is also the Giriama name. In Swahili it is *mbaraka*. In English it is the long-pod cassia. The Mgombato dictionary uses *muhumba* for a different plant, *Cassia occidentalis*, and Pakia gives *muhumba* to the winter cassia, *Senna singueana*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *muhumba tsaka*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *muhumba mkulu*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kigiriama. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mbaraka*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *long-pod cassia*. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatumia *muhumba* kwa mmea mwingine, *Cassia occidentalis*, na Pakia inalitoa jina *muhumba* kwa *winter cassia*, *Senna singueana*.

reason.en: Winter cassia, which shares the muhumba name
Another bush tree with medicinal bark
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wa vichakani wenye gome la dawa

reason.en: Another pod-bearing tree of the bean family
reason.sw: Mti mwingine wenye maganda wa jamii ya kunde
